Ask on WhatsApp
What's included in each Rivaaj Box?

Each kit holds the essentials and samagri for one ceremony. Open any kit to see exactly what's inside.

Can I order more than one kit?

Yes. Order as many kits as your celebrations need, in a single WhatsApp conversation.

How do I place an order?

Tap "Order Now" on any kit. WhatsApp opens with your kit already named in the message, and we take it from there.

Can I customise a kit?

Message us on WhatsApp with what you need and we'll tell you what's possible for your family's customs.

How early should I order?

As early as you can. Share your ceremony dates on WhatsApp and we'll confirm timing with you.

Do you deliver?

Tell us your location on WhatsApp and we'll confirm delivery details with you.

Can I order kits for multiple ceremonies?

Yes. Tell us which rasams you're preparing for and we'll help you put together the right set.
